policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Catawba have scored twenty-four and conceded three, and no one player has more than Alex Payton's four of those goals.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Every side in the conference has now won at least once; Lenoir-Rhyne's first came at Newberry on Saturday.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Six matches whose dates have passed carry no result: Newberry's opener at Converse, and the rest of them Emory & Henry's, from late August to mid-September.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Tusculum's defeat at home to Catawba on Sunday was their fourth of the season, against one win and one draw, and they have scored four goals in all.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Emory & Henry are unbeaten with two wins and two draws, nine scored and four conceded, and go to Mars Hill on Tuesday.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Lenoir-Rhyne's win at Newberry on Saturday was their first of the season: one win, three draws and five defeats, twelve scored and twenty-one conceded.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Wingate's Cole Freeman has made thirty-three saves and conceded seven goals.
